definitions.explanation: Liquid medication applied directly to the eyes, used for dry eyes, allergies, or other eye conditions.

examples.japanese: {目|め}が{乾|かわ}くので{目薬|めぐすり}が{手放|てばな}せない。
examples.english: My eyes get dry so I can't be without eye drops.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}の{季節|きせつ}は{目薬|めぐすり}をよく{使|つか}う。
examples.english: I use eye drops a lot during hay fever season.

notes:
{目薬|めぐすり} is used for various eye conditions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {目薬|めぐすり}をさす (to put in eye drops)
- {目薬|めぐすり}を{使|つか}う (to use eye drops)

COMMON TYPES:
- {疲|つか}れ{目|め}{用|よう} (for tired eyes)
- ドライアイ{用|よう} (for dry eyes)
- {花粉症|かふんしょう}{用|よう} (for hay fever)
- {充血|じゅうけつ}{除去|じょきょ}{用|よう} (for reducing redness)

RELATED TERMS:
- {点眼薬|てんがんやく}: eye drops (formal/medical)
- {目|め}: eye
- {視力|しりょく}: eyesight
